paper_title: First constraints on QCD axion dark matter using James Webb Space Telescope observations
notes: Paper (arXiv:2503.11753, Pinetti) sets 95% CL limits on g_agamma from axion DM decay in the Milky Way halo using JWST MIRI (0.1-0.5 eV) and NIRSpec (0.5-4 eV) blank-sky observations. No numerical table is provided; data_points are approximate values estimated from the description of Fig. 2 (limits span roughly 1e-12 to few 1e-11 GeV^-1 over 0.1-4 eV, improving previous bounds by up to two orders of magnitude, strongest near ~1 eV where Galactic Center observations dominate). Assumes NFW halo (rs=24 kpc, rho_s=0.18 GeV/cm^3) and that axions are all of DM; this is an indirect-detection decay search, not a haloscope, so dm_density_assumed is left null.
